about.welcome: Welcome to a curated digital space built for those who believe stories form who we become.
about.content: In an age of endless content, intention matters more than volume. Every book, idea, and recommendation you find here is selected with care, designed to inspire curiosity, deepen emotional understanding, and open new ways of seeing the world.
about.spia-role: Spia doesn't just organize content. It connects meaning.
about.feeling: • Feeling. Stories that help us understand ourselves and others
about.thinking: • Thinking. Ideas that challenge, question, and expand our perspective
about.growing: • Growing. Tools that support lifelong learning, from early childhood to adulthood
about.kidscorner.desc: The first branch, <kc>KidsCorner</kc>, is dedicated to young readers and the adults guiding them. It focuses on books that nurture emotional intelligence, cultural awareness, and a genuine love for reading, without overwhelming choice.

legal.privacy.content:
Last updated: 11/05/2026

Spia is independently operated from Canada and is committed to respecting visitor privacy across its platform sections, including KidsCorner.

Information Collected

Spia does not currently collect personal information such as names, mailing addresses, or payment details directly through the website. However, certain technical and usage data may be collected automatically through website hosting services, analytics tools, cookies, affiliate tracking systems, and third-party integrations. This information may include: IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, referral sources, and browsing behavior.

Cookies & Analytics

Spia may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to improve website functionality and analyze traffic patterns. Third-party services, including affiliate partners such as Amazon or bookstore platforms, may also use cookies to track referral activity and purchases. Visitors may disable cookies through their browser settings.

Affiliate Tracking

Spia and its content sections, including KidsCorner, may participate in affiliate marketing programs, including the Amazon Associates Program, Indigo affiliate programs, and other bookstore or retail partnerships. Affiliate providers may use cookies or tracking technologies to record referral activity and qualifying purchases. Please refer to the respective third-party privacy policies for more information regarding their data practices.

Social Media & External Platforms

Spia may maintain and distribute content through third-party platforms including Instagram, Pinterest, and similar services. Interactions on those platforms are governed by their respective privacy policies and terms of service.

Children’s Privacy

Spia and KidsCorner provide informational content for parents, guardians, and educators. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13.

Visitor Rights

Depending on location, visitors may have rights to:

  • Disable cookies through browser settings
  • Limit tracking through browser privacy tools
  • Discontinue website use at any time

Contact

For privacy-related inquiries: spia.s@hotmail.com
legal.affiliate.content:

Affiliate partnerships may include Amazon Associates, Indigo affiliate programs, independent bookstores, and other retail or publishing partners. Recommendations and curated selections are published independently with the intention of providing value, discovery, and useful resources to readers, families, parents, guardians, and educators. Participation in affiliate programs does not guarantee sponsorship, endorsement, or paid promotion unless explicitly stated.

As an Amazon Associate, Spia earns from qualifying purchases.
